theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {γ : Type u_3} {mα : MeasurableSpace α} {mγ : MeasurableSpace γ} [MeasurableSpace.CountablyGenerated γ] (κ : ProbabilityTheory.Kernel α (γ × ℝ)) [ProbabilityTheory.IsFiniteKernel κ] : ProbabilityTheory.IsRatCondKernelCDF (fun p q => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic ↑q)) κ κ.fst := by
  constructor
  · intros p q
    exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.density_nonneg κ p.1 p.2
  · intros p q
    exact ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.density_le_one κ p.1 p.2
  · intros p q
    rw [ProbabilityTheory.integral_Iic_eq_cdf]
    have h : Measurable (fun x : ℝ => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic x)) :=
      by apply ProbabilityTheory.measurable_density; exact κ.fst
    have i : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => κ.density κ.fst p.1 p.2 (Set.Iic x)) :=
      by apply ProbabilityTheory.integrable_density; exact κ.fst
    exact (ProbabilityTheory.setIntegral_density κ.fst p.1 p.2 i).symm
  · exact (ProbabilityTheory.Kernel.density_fst_univ κ).symm
